latency.definition: criterion (i) between the two independent measurements of the same trial's imposed delay, (with - without) against (with - repeat), on the latency definition
latency.deviation: no HOLDOUT pair carries a repeat; the denominator is the FIT repeat pairs of the same 24 cells as the numerator

ttft.definition: criterion (i) between the two independent measurements of the same trial's imposed delay, (with - without) against (with - repeat), on the ttft definition
ttft.deviation: no HOLDOUT pair carries a repeat; the denominator is the FIT repeat pairs of the same 24 cells as the numerator

regression_stop.rule: the brief's gate: pol6 must not be worse than pol4 on (ii) or (iii) on FIT
regression_stop.consequence: pol6 is NOT frozen and pol4 remains the frozen and default model

criterion_iv.note: StudyENG1e measures per-step membership under load, not prefix survival, so (iv) has no ENG1e evidence and is neither re-run nor re-scored here.

assertions: the record's holdout flag selects exactly the split file's trial count, counted over both injection modes
no trial of the other split is constructed at all
every scored trial carries a with arm and a without arm

two_compensating_errors.finding: pol4 reproduces a chained rebuild's OWN span to 1.03 to 1.13 only because two errors cancel in it: its piece STEP is 1.06 to 1.62x too long and its hand-over WINDOW is 3 to 13x too short. Neither cancels in the delay charged to OTHERS, which is why the chain imposed-delay ratio is 1.08 to 2.47 while the span ratio is near 1.
two_compensating_errors.consequence: correcting the window alone fixes criterion (i) and breaks criterion (iii); correcting the step means re-fitting the FROZEN step model, which is outside Part B and would move mono, where pol4 is already right.
